summary: CI: every PR/push runs G-RUST (fmt, both clippy) and the full test matrix that contains G-TASK (tasks, tasks_headless, tui_task), plus G-LOAD(200) on the release binary in the stage1-host job; a new load.yml runs G-LOAD(2000) nightly (03:17 UTC) or on demand with an agents count and runner label. load_agents.py reads /proc on Linux.
commands_run: yaml parse of ci.yml and load.yml
notes: The §2.1 budget assumes 16 cores; GitHub ubuntu-latest has 4, so the scheduled 2000-agent run is a trend signal unless dispatched with a larger runner label.
